packageRules.description: Run go mod tidy after every Go module update
Pin GitHub Actions to SHA for security
Hold every update for 7 days so a malicious or yanked release is caught before it lands
A digest update carries no release timestamp, so under the default timestamp-required its stability-days status would stay pending forever; the hold still applies where the registry gives a timestamp
Release runs on the better-semantic-release fork — never let an update swap it back to upstream python-semantic-release

@n24q02m/hull is released by this stack and consumed right after release. bunfig.toml exempts it from bun's minimumReleaseAge; this rule, last so no later rule re-applies a hold, keeps Renovate from holding it either, so the version Renovate proposes is the one bun locks.
